home.headline: Disputes ka solution. Efficiently. Confidentially. Decisively.

home.profileText: Karan Khetan India aur United States mein family, civil aur commercial disputes handle karne wale parties ke saath kaam karte hain.
home.fasterText: Zyaadatar matters ek se teen sessions mein resolve ho jaate hain—litigation se kaafi jaldi.
